Features

  • Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine

    The Aspect of the Wolverine grants you the tools to relentlessly pursue your prey.

    When you attack a  Bleeding or  Poisoned target, you also  Maim it for 1 turn

  • Danger Sense

    Advantage on DEX saves against traps, spells, surfaces. Cannot be Blind or Incapacitated.

  • Eagle Heart

    Enter an eagle-like rage.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Fast Movement

    Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m / 10 ft while not wearing Heavy Armour.

  • Feral Instinct

    You gain a +3 to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Tenacity

    Upon missing a melee attack, still deals bludgeoning damage equal to STR modifier or a minimum of 1.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    While unarmoured, adds constitution modifier to AC.

Stats

WYR_SmugglersCave_Human_Barbarian
Shiv Dahlia is a human follower of the Stone Lord.

Involvement

Dahlia can be found in the middle of an argument with the Guild on the Western Beach in Rivington during Act Three.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Dash ()

Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed.

 Range: Self
 Diving Strike ()   –  Greatclub
Damage: 5~12
1d8 + 4⁠Bludgeoning
Leap down unto a foe below you, dealing normal weapon damage and knocking them  Prone.

You do not take falling damage. You must be at least 1.5 m (5 ft) above your target.

Available only when  Raging.

 Range:  Jump range
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Greatclub
Damage: 5~12
1d8 + 4⁠Bludgeoning
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Rage: Eagle Heart ( + )

Enter a  Rage that makes you near untouchable.

You can use  Diving Strike.

Foes also have  Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use  Dash as a bonus action.

 Range: Self
 Reckless Attack ()   –  Greatclub
Damage: 5~12
1d8 + 4⁠Bludgeoning
Throw all caution in the wind to gain  Advantage on your melee  Attack Roll.

Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you.

 Range: Normal weapon range
